description:
Meta-Model-Environment.
  Collection of all data about your datauniverse (= meta data)

Models.description: List of all models building up the meta model

Derivations.description: List derivations, connecting elements semantically cross-models

Mappings.description: List Mappings, linking LOV-values of different LOV's together. Can connect LOV-values cross models

Transformations.description: List transformations from any dataelements to any other dataelements.

Sources.description: List of external sources providing information restricting, explaining, or enhancing the my definitions.

Organisations.description: Corporation (association, federation, cooperative, standards organisation, consortium) that are mostly non-profit-oriented..

elementid.description: unique ID of the organisation for reference purposes

name.description: Name of the source. unique within the MME

email.description: main email address of the organisation

url.description: worldwide uniqe reference where to find the documentation

additionalProps.description: additional properties (aka user defined properties udp) are  any properties of an this element  added by the current modeller. They serve as an extension to the predfefined element properties.
